items.shortLine: Meet Tamar for your Day 1 walkthrough
items.detailText: You'll spend part of your first day with Tamar Navon, your manager, walking through your onboarding plan and what to expect over the next few months.
A short session with HR to get you set up — benefits, logistics, and anything else you need to feel settled in.

items.shortLine: Say hello to Amit, your skip-level
items.detailText: A quick intro with Amit Cohen, VP Engineering, who leads the broader org your team sits in.
Time to connect one-on-one with Emily Morris, one of your direct reports — a good first step in getting to know how they work.
Time to connect one-on-one with Gili Harari, one of your direct reports.
Time to connect one-on-one with Lior Peretz, one of your direct reports.
Time to connect one-on-one with Miguel Thomas, one of your direct reports.
Time to connect one-on-one with Roni Levin, one of your direct reports.
Time to connect one-on-one with Yoni Shor, one of your direct reports — rounding out your first week of getting to know the team.
Your email, calendar, and shared drive are all set up before you even start — one less thing to sort out on day one.
Slack access lands on Day 1 — it's where the team hangs out and gets things done day to day.
Notion access is ready Day 1 — it's home to Veridian's handbooks, docs, and team knowledge.
HiBob is Veridian's HR system — your profile, time off, and the org chart, ready to go on Day 1.
Jira access arrives Day 2, once approved — that's where the team tracks its work.
GitHub access is ready Day 3, after approval and the security training below.
Figma access lands Day 3 — handy for following along on product and design work.
A short self-paced course covering the security basics everyone at Veridian needs to know.
A quick read on how we work together and what's expected of everyone at Veridian.
A self-guided read through the handful of policies that matter most day to day — hybrid work, security, code review, deployments, expenses, and customer data.
A short read on what the Connectors team owns and how it fits into Engineering's broader goals.
Your manager will assign you a Human Buddy soon — they'll be your go-to person for the everyday questions and how things really work around here.
Your manager will pair you with a Professional Mentor soon to help with deeper guidance in your role — we'll let you know as soon as that's set.
Time to connect one-on-one with Eli Sasson, one of your direct reports.
Time to connect one-on-one with Elliot Carter, one of your direct reports.
Time to connect one-on-one with Rachel Clarke, one of your direct reports.
Time to connect one-on-one with Sofia White, one of your direct reports.
Time to connect one-on-one with Yair Shani, one of your direct reports — the last of your eleven direct 1:1s this fortnight.
A short course on data privacy fundamentals, required for everyone at Veridian.
A quick course on how Veridian reviews code, worth knowing as you start guiding your team's reviews too.
A deeper course on writing secure code, tailored for engineers.

items.shortLine: Check in with Tamar at 30 days
items.detailText: A dedicated session with Tamar to look back at your first month, flag anything that's off track, and re-prioritize together.
A focused course on the fundamentals of managing at Veridian — team rhythms, coaching, and what's expected of you as a people manager.

internalGaps: No explicit interface map exists for Veridian teams - nothing in this employee's context identifies which specific teams Connectors interfaces with, so no Local/Global interface-contact meetings could be scheduled. Needs a data source or a manager-intake answer.

Framework part C §9 defines 30/60/90-day check-ins; this plan's schema only covers 8 weeks (56 days), so only the day-30 checkpoint is included. Day-60 and day-90 check-ins need to be scheduled once the plan extends past week 8.
This plan does not include applied 'doing' work tickets (out of scope by design for this pipeline).
